decisions.reason: As a close extension of the modular sensing platform launched only in 2023, it is still an inexpensive option to keep open because market learning is incomplete and its fit with the firm’s existing architecture is strong.

Its own dedicated page suggests meaningful commercial intent, and as an industrial input module closely aligned with the established automation range it should be retained while uncertainty resolves further.
A solid state relay module is a natural complement to the firm’s control and automation building blocks, so the low incremental cost and high ecosystem fit favor keeping it on the market.

Although only lightly evidenced so far, this kit leverages the firm’s existing sensors, controllers and documentation, making it a low-cost option worth retaining for another period rather than abandoning prematurely.
